recognize_zh: CD30 免疫染色中，大部分大型腫瘤細胞為陰性，只有零星幾顆大細胞呈弱至中度胞質/膜狀棕色染色；在灰區淋巴瘤中，CD30 表現不一致、未如典型何杰金細胞般強陽性。
features: Sheet of medium-to-large cells with vesicular, irregular nuclei, most negative for CD30
Rare scattered large cells with weak to moderate cytoplasmic/membranous CD30 staining
No Golgi (paranuclear dot) accentuation evident in the positive cells
No diffuse strong CD30 expression across the large cell population
describe_en: CD30 immunohistochemistry shows that the large atypical cell population is predominantly negative, with only rare scattered large cells demonstrating weak to moderate cytoplasmic and membranous staining. Strong membranous and Golgi-pattern CD30 staining typical of Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells is not seen. In conjunction with the morphology and the remaining immunopanel, this limited CD30 expression supports a B-cell lymphoma with features intermediate between diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and classic Hodgkin lymphoma (mediastinal gray zone lymphoma).

ddx.vs: cHL shows strong CD30 in essentially all Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells with membranous and Golgi staining, together with weak/absent CD20 and Oct-2.
PMBL often shows weak heterogeneous CD30 but has uniform strong CD20/Oct-2 with CD23/MAL expression and lacks CD15.
ALCL shows strong uniform CD30 in nearly all tumor cells with a T-cell or null phenotype.
